item.title: CakePHP vs CodeIgniter 4 vs Phalcon in 2026: Are Classic PHP MVC Frameworks Still Worth Choosing?
item.description: Every PHP job posting screams Laravel or Symfony — yet millions of production sites still run on the three frameworks that built modern PHP MVC: CakePHP, CodeIgniter, and Phalcon. If you are inheriting one of those codebases, or you need a framework that runs on a $5 shared host instead of a Kubernetes cluster, the “classic” trio is not nostalgia — it is a practical decision with very different trade-offs in 2026.
